verdict.rationale: Column's own docs say it offers KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing, or lets you bring your own process. That is first-party evidence of programmatic customer verification for both individuals and businesses, but it is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented document-collection flows, watchlist/sanctions screening, explicitly modeled application/verification states, KYC/KYB API endpoint details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
